browser_login_only: Only when signed in via the browser
browser_login_only_fields: Can only be changed when signed in via the browser: {fields}
login_too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts – please try again in {wait} s
login_weak_password_external: Login from outside is blocked: the admin password is too weak (change ADMIN_PASSWORD)
since_before_until: “since” must be before “until” or before now
nightly_running: A nightly run is already in progress
token_generate_failed: Could not generate a unique key
merge_kind_mismatch: Only identities of the same kind can be merged
max_images: max. {limit} images – delete old ones first
max_samples: max. {limit} samples – delete old ones first
merge_already_undone: This merge has already been undone
merge_target_gone: Target no longer exists – undo the later merge first
merge_source_exists: The source identity already exists again
image_not_in_source: At least one selected image does not belong to the source
analysis_busy: Analysis service busy – please try again in a moment
history_no_pgvector: Time machine not available (database without pgvector)
tv_too_many_streams: Too many TV streams at the same time
tv_probe_unreachable: TV {host} not reachable or no UPnP device description (switched on?)
tv_not_dlna: Device is not a DLNA player (no AVTransport service)
tv_address_invalid: TV address: IP address or http://… URL of the device description
tv_stream_base_url_missing: Address for TVs (tv_stream_base_url) is not set
ptz_not_enabled: PTZ is not enabled for this camera
ptz_preset_is_home: This is the home position – choose a different home position first
ptz_preset_in_patrol: Position is used in the patrol – remove it there first
ptz_no_host_onvif: Camera URL contains no host – ONVIF not possible
ptz_preset_missing: Position {token} does not exist on the camera
onvif_no_ptz: Camera does not offer PTZ control via ONVIF
onvif_no_media_service: Camera reports no ONVIF media service
onvif_profile_missing: Media profile {profile} does not exist on the camera
vlm_service_down: Image model not available (service vlm is not running – Compose profile vlm)
vlm_cloud_not_allowed: Cloud not allowed for this camera
vlm_cloud_not_configured: Image model not available (cloud model not set up)
vlm_local_disabled: Local image model is switched off (Settings → Ask the camera)
llm_not_configured: No language model set up (Settings → AI language model)
llm_no_model: No model entered (Settings → AI language model)
llm_no_base_url: No base URL entered (Settings → AI language model)
youtube_unavailable: YouTube live stream not available (offline or not a live stream)
sensor_item_or_question: Specify an item (in English, e.g. “bottles”) or your own question for the image model
sensor_out_below_low: “Empty below” must be smaller than “Low below”
sensor_question_missing: Question for the image model missing
sensor_verify_count_max: Confirmation by image model only up to a minimum count of {max} (the image model undercounts larger amounts)
sensor_supply_level_only: Supply only with the states ok/low/empty (fill level, count items or image model with count/fill level)
sensor_verify_kinds: Confirmation by image model only for brightness, blinking, reference images and count items
sensor_verify_question: Specify a question for the confirmation by image model
sensor_vlm_interval: Image model sensors: interval at least 60 s
sensor_vlm_supply_age: Supplies by image model: “check again at the latest after” at least 30 min (every question pauses item detection and the time machine)
sensor_refs_kinds: Reference images only for the kinds “Reference images” and “Fill level”
sensor_refs_max: At most {max} references per state – delete old ones first
item_threshold_range: Threshold per item must be between 0.05 and 0.95
repeat_s_min: repeat_s must be 0 or at least 10 s
server_url_scheme: Server must start with http:// or https://
ntfy_topic_required: ntfy needs a topic (letters, digits, _ and -)
pushover_keys_required: Pushover needs a user key and an app token
webhook_url_scheme: Webhook URL must start with http:// or https://
field_url_scheme: {field} must start with http:// or https://
push_target_ids_unique: Push target IDs must be unique
rule_condition_track_only: Condition {index} ({type}) only works with track triggers, not with {trigger}
vlm_local_off_no_cloud: Image model not available (local model off, no cloud)
